items.rationale: Under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.2, the fixed kitchen unit is eligible if the surge was atmospheric in origin and the fire group was in force; neither is confirmed. The like-for-like allowance under §§7.1.9–7.1.10 is 1 × €1,413 gross.

Under §7.1.11, necessary installation follows the covered replacement at 1 × €480 gross. If the line also includes unrelated equipment installation or a general wiring check, §9.5 requires those costs to be separated.

Under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.9, the console is eligible only if it was damaged or its replacement was necessary for covered reinstatement; the description establishes that a console existed, but not that it needed replacing. If payable, the allowance is 1 × €61 gross.
Under §7.1.11, necessary freight for covered AC replacement is eligible at 1 × €43 gross. Any share attributable to unrelated or excluded equipment must be separated before payment.
